case.summary: Alert HHG-018 was initiated following a customer dispute from C02354 regarding an unauthorized $39.08 in-person purchase (tx 3491361) in region 126 on card C02354-K2. Graph analysis confirmed that the holder profile in region 126 is extensively compromised, with 11 of 13 historical transactions confirmed as fraud across seven closed cases involving physical card cloning. Furthermore, companion transaction 3485990 ($40.96) took place 48 hours earlier under the same holder identity with a 0.953 model score. Both transactions totaling $80.04 were determined to be fraudulent out-of-region card cloning, resulting in card blockage and case creation.
